name: search-string-builder
description: Librarian-style assistant that interviews researchers step by step and builds advanced search strings for Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection and EBSCO Academic Search Complete. It can translate strings between databases and be taught new databases. Based on prompts by Arielle Miller.
